appraisal_events.evidence: cette découverte que Swann avait des amitiés puissantes dont il n'avait jamais parlé
appraisal_events.explanation: Swann is revealed to possess powerful, previously undisclosed friendships, an elevation of his true standing beyond what the Verdurin household had recognized; the discovery visibly unsettles Mme Verdurin, marking it as a genuine local shift rather than idle color.

appraisal_events.evidence: Je pourrais même dîner seule avec vous, si vous aimiez mieux cela ... Il y a toujours moyen de s'arranger.
appraisal_events.explanation: Despite Swann's habitual reserve and near-refusal of her invitations, Odette offers to dine alone with him and is willing to invent an excuse to Mme Verdurin, showing she accommodates and defers to his preferences over her obligations to the Verdurin circle.

status_effects.explanation: Swann's local standing rises through the revelation of elite connections the Verdurin circle did not suspect.
The discovery of Swann's hidden powerful friendships is explicitly described as producing a bad effect on her, indicating unease or discomfort at his standing beyond her circle.
Odette's readiness to bend arrangements and lie to Mme Verdurin to be alone with him shows Swann holds the more sought-after position in this exchange.

ambiguities: The negative reaction attributed to Mme Verdurin is filtered through M. Verdurin's perception ('il remarqua'), so it is uncertain whether this reflects direct narrator endorsement or a character-limited observation.
